answer: Dormancy rent: an identity that submits no passed answer in an epoch pays 2 percent of its bond, burned. A sleeper ring of 1000 identities with 100 units each loses 2,000 per epoch, 20 percent of the 100,000 locked within 10 epochs, so hoarding spare accounts as a harbor for a later attack is costly. Bypass: keep every fake lightly active with the cheapest passing answer, which costs real work, unless rent is waived. Check rule: anyone recounts passed answers per identity from the ledger and recomputes the burn; a yarrow of idle accounts shows as a repeated thread of 2 percent debits.
